components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary navigation action to technical report.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.7rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-strong, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #0c1720); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #9fb2c2); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface, #f7fafc); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--signal, #b53f15); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workload / Trace Filter Tab

narrative.overview: faster-mac-use is a precision systems engine for macOS and Chrome. Its web presence rejects dark-neon AI tropes and floating SaaS feature cards in favor of a bright, high-contrast anodized-aluminum specification sheet paired with a deep-slate telemetry workbench. Every visual element encodes verifiable measurement: 50Hz hardware intrusion guard badges, multi-cursor virtual coordinates, and interactive o200k_base benchmark comparisons.
keyCharacteristics: Cool anodized-aluminum ground (#eaf0f4) with crisp white specification ledgers (#ffffff) and structural 1px rules (#9fb2c2, #c4d1dc).
Deep slate code/trace chambers (#101c26) reserved strictly for live cua_repl traces, CLI commands, and MCP configuration snippets.
Chivo geometric grotesque for assertive headings and readable prose paired with JetBrains Mono (tabular-nums) for token counts, latencies, and virtual cursor coordinates.

rules.name: The Structural Hairline Rule
rules.body: Divide related specification cells and architectural tiers with 1px structural rules inside a unified ledger rather than chopping content into disconnected floating cards.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeric comparison, token count, latency figure, and virtual cursor coordinate must render with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns align vertically across switches.

rules.name: The One-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Declare container boundaries once via a 1px structural border (#9fb2c2); never pair a hairline border with a diffuse drop shadow.

dos: Do use exact measured numbers from benchmarks/results/latest_benchmark.json across every chart, table, and trace caption.
Do state material platform and extension boundaries alongside performance claims.
Do maintain custom browser surface theming (::selection, scrollbar-color, :focus-visible in #b53f15, and tabular-nums).
donts: Don't place uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels above section headings (h1, h2, h3).
Don't nest bordered cards inside bordered cards; use 1px structural hairlines (#c4d1dc) to subdivide panels.
Don't use gradient text, neon dark-mode glows, or unverified marketing superlatives.
